<b>Berry Picking</b> is a [[Gather Wishes|Gather Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, started by talking to the [[Moss Druid]] in [[Mosshome]] or by accepting the Wish from the [[Bone Bottom]] Wishwall, which becomes active after defeating the [[Bell Beast]].

== Wish ==
[[File:Mossberry.png|link=Mossberry|left|thumb|100x100px]]

The Moss Druid asks [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to retrieve 3 [[Mossberry|Mossberries]] from various locations across [[Pharloom]], and return them to the Moss Druid's cave in Mosshome. Most of the berries are located in and around Bone Bottom, with the final berry in the [[Memorium]] only accessible later in the game.

== Reward ==
[[File:Druid's Eye.png|link=Druid's Eye|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After delivering three berries to Moss Druid, they reward Hornet with the [[Druid's Eye]]. After completing the wish, they continue to accept additional Mossberries in exchange for [[Rosaries]], and reward Hornet with the upgraded [[Druid's Eye]]s once all berries have been delivered.
{{Clear}}
